correctness.rationale: An injective \(q+1\)-dimensional fiber parametrization with Jacobian \(\sqrt{q+2}\) is established; its marginal weight \(W=\sum_j(1-|t_j|)\), cube moments \(\mathbb E_0W=q/2\), \(\mathbb E_0W^3=q^2(q+1)/8\) and \(\mathbb E_0(t_j^2W)=(2q-1)/12\) yield the exact covariance. Orthogonal Gram eigenclasses, trace, determinant, and the polynomial \(q^3-3q^2-6q+4\) establish the crossover for all \(q\ge3\). Separately implemented finite numerical integrations verify \(q=2,3,4\); Monte Carlo checks \(q=5,8,15\). No infinite claim is inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: A natural high-dimensional overlapping-cycle family lacks a product decomposition; the distinction between generator-uniform and intrinsic-volume-uniform sampling is mathematically substantive. The theorem yields full covariance tensor, exact volume, intrinsic inertia, affine invariant and a sharp top-eigenspace swap at exactly five leaves. This qualitative transition is not routine restatement of known facet, circumsphere, or Löwner data.
